propositions: Adapter must expose parse_structured and check_response as Pydantic output policy through TextOutput function and after_model_request capability without adding new retry loop or scheduling logic
Retryable StructuredOutputError from parse_structured must raise ModelRetry preserving the original Rebar error in __cause__ chain for Pydantic-driven bounded retry
Stop/refusal checks via check_response must run in after_model_request hook before output parsing and raise UnretryableOutputError terminal failure without Pydantic retry prompt
Historical deterministic repair, sentinel extraction, and decoy selection behavior must be preserved byte-for-byte when routed through the adapter
Agent wired with TextOutput function and capability must return typed object for valid responses and surface exact Rebar error identity through ModelRetry cause chain on recoverable failures
